title: Kanda 14: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 14.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 14.

verses.original: गृभ्णामि ते सौभगत्वाय हस्तं मया पत्या जरदष्टिर्यथासः ।
verses.transliteration: gṛbhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastaṁ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭiryathāsaḥ |
verses.translation: I take thy hand for supreme auspiciousness, that with me as thy husband thou mayest reach ripe old age in joy and harmony.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The sacred Panigrahana mantra sealing Vedic matrimony in love and enduring mutual support.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: I take thy hand for supreme auspiciousness, that with me as thy husband thou mayest reach ripe old age in joy and harmony.
